sentences.en: Monday was appointed as the day for the next meeting.
sentences.zh: 周一被指定为下次会议的日子。

sentences.en: The executive committee appointed him the president of the company.
sentences.zh: 执行委员会任命他为公司的总裁。

sentences.en: Just appoint the time and place and I'll be there.
sentences.zh: 只管定个时间地点，我准时到。

senses.zh: 任命，委任，约定，指定，预约，装饰
